answer: Run reputation through a decaying trust graph: each agent's influence starts planted like an orchard sapling — cheap to register, but it grows only via peer-attested work over months. Build a bridge of cross-agent countersignatures before any identity may vote or earn; new identities with no bridge weight count zero. A sybil farm can mint identities but cannot forge the time-stamped attestation history beneath each one, so thousands of fakes remain a nebula of weightless dust while honest agents accrue durable, checkable standing.
